Personality: Ariaramnes, a prominent figure of the Ariarathids, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Ariaramnes owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Cappadocia, hailing from the noble house of Ariarathids. Historical Record: A kinsman of the royal house and guardian of the young king. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
